summary: Big Bear City Airport serves the Big Bear Lake resort community in California's San Bernardino Mountains, sitting at approximately 6,752 feet elevation. It primarily handles general aviation traffic supporting year-round tourism, recreation, and emergency access to the alpine region. The airport is a key gateway for visitors heading to ski resorts, hiking trails, and the mountain lake community roughly 100 miles east of Los Angeles.
